en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is neither Compulsion nor Delegation, but there is a matter between the two matters’.

I said, ‘And what is the matter between the two matters?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘An example of that is a man you see upon disobedience. So you forbid him, so he does not finish it. So you neglect him (for a while). Then he commits that very disobedience. Therefore it isn’t so when he did not accept from you, so you neglected him, you came to be the one who instructed him with the disobedience’.
